yt.title: Argentina's economy was 43% of Brazil's in 2000. Now? #Shorts
yt.description:
GDP in current US dollars, Argentina as a share of Brazil, 2000 vs 2025. Source: World Bank (NY.GDP.MKTP.CD). Exchange rates affect this comparison.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Argentina and Brazil are the two biggest economies in South America. Here is how the gap between them changed.
In 2000, Argentina's economy was forty-three percent the size of Brazil's. By 2025, it was thirty percent.
Argentina's currency has swung wildly, so dollar comparisons move a lot from year to year. What would you compare next?
